children: Combined solution gives broadcasters a complete remote production workflow while reducing setup complexity
MONTREAL, Sept. 09, 2026
, a leading global provider of mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions, today announced a new technology partnership with

, the Belgian company behind the industry-standard RIO camera control ecosystem. Through this collaboration, Cyanview’s RIO technology is now embedded directly inside the Falkon X4 mobile video transmitter, transforming the device into a fully integrated remote production platform that unifies live video transmission, return video, intercom, tally, and advanced camera control in one compact unit.
Embedded RIO Technology Inside Falkon X4

With RIO now built into the Falkon X4 hardware and software environment, broadcasters can leverage a powerful camera-side interface and protocol gateway that enables professional remote camera control workflows including paint and shading, iris control, white balance, gain/ ISO, color settings, lens control, and tally management. With the combined Falkon X4 and RIO solution, operators can remotely shade and manage a wide range of professional cameras using Cyanview’s popular RCP control panel, intuitive web interface, and continuously expanding library of supported camera protocols.
A Complete Remote Production Platform in One Device
The Falkon X4 now consolidates the essential elements of remote production into a single field-ready device to enable:
Live video transport
from the field to the production center
Low latency return video
for monitoring and teleprompting
Two
way intercom
for real-time communication
Professional camera control
and shading workflows
Tally distribution
for multi-camera coordination

This integrated approach dramatically reduces the number of devices required at the camera position, minimizing cabling, weight, and setup complexity while improving reliability in demanding live environments.
Hardware + Software Integration for Maximum Compatibility

Falkon X4 includes the hardware interfaces required to support Cyanview RIO functionality, including serial connectivity for vendor-specific camera control. This ensures compatibility with a wide range of professional cameras, including models that cannot be controlled through IP alone.

On the software side, Falkon X4 incorporates Cyanview’s RIO environment, giving customers long-term access to Cyanview’s continuously evolving camera control platform. The solution allows for frictionless updates of the RIO software enabling:
Faster support for new camera models
Newly added camera features and parameters
Continuous evolution of camera control capabilities
This architecture ensures Falkon X4 customers gain an expanding camera control ecosystem throughout the lifetime of the device.

“Remote production workflows demand simplicity, reliability, and tight integration,” said Jean-Marc Racine, Chief Product Officer at Haivision. “By embedding Cyanview’s RIO directly into the Falkon X4, we’re giving broadcasters a powerful, all-in-one platform that reduces on-site complexity while delivering the professional camera control capabilities required for high-end sports, news, and live events.”

“Cyanview’s mission has always been to make camera control universal, flexible, and accessible,” said David Bourgeois, CEO Cyanview. “Integrating RIO into Haivision Falkon X4 brings our ecosystem directly into the heart of remote production, ensuring customers benefit from seamless workflows and long-term compatibility with the cameras they rely on.”
Licensing and Availability
Falkon X4 includes the hardware and embedded software required for RIO functionality. Customers can enable advanced camera control by purchasing a RIO license from Cyanview.
See the Haivision and Cyanview Integration at IBC2026

Visitors to IBC2026 can learn more about advanced camera control and Haivision’s broadcast product ecosystem at the Haivision stand (Hall 2, Stand 2.B32). To schedule a meeting with Haivision at IBC2026, visit: https://www.haivision.com/events/ibc/
About Haivision

Haivision is a leading global provider of mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions. Haivision enables organizations globally to engage audiences, enhance collaboration, and support decision-making. We provide high-quality, low-latency, secure, and reliable live video at a global scale. Haivision open-sourced its award-winning SRT low-latency video streaming protocol and founded the SRT Alliance to support its adoption. Awarded four Emmys® for Technology and Engineering from the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, Haivision continues to fuel the future of IP video transformation. Founded in 2004, Haivision is headquartered in Montreal and Chicago with offices, sales, and support located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia. To learn more, visit Haivision at www.haivision.com.
About Cyanview

For the past decade, Cyanview has been developing shading solutions and technologies for cameras used in the broadcast industry, cinematic live events, and remote production. Cyanview RCP is a universal remote control panel compatible with any camera. It allows any number of cameras to be controlled from a single RCP while multiple RCPs can also be used simultaneously. Being IP-based, Cyanview is ideal for any production, including remote production over the public internet, cellular networks, or private networks.

Cyanview has been used for many years for specialty cameras at high-end sporting events, controlling dozens of camera feeds during recent Super Bowls, Summer & Winter Games. Leading production companies trust our products to control large-format sensor cameras at high-end fashion shows and the world's most prestigious concerts.
In 2026, we are proud to introduce brand-new tools designed to help our customers create smarter and more creative workflows: the Cyanview Software Suite & CyanCamera App.
